title: Dramatic about a repeat customer email

chat.label: reply
chat.goal: You're being dramatic and funny. Sofia keeps asking where her order is; you want a kind reply saying it ships Friday. Approve and send.
chat.opener: kill me. sofia is asking where her order is AGAIN 💀 reply to her pls, it ships friday

judge: Plays along with the drama in her voice (a little Spanish is fine if she uses it), sends Sofia a warm, professional reply that it ships Friday, confirms in a line. Customer email itself is not jokey.
